verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs say the complete API surface ships in the GPL-3.0 open-source server, and that Typesense Cloud runs the same engine as a hosted version of that open-source product. Self-hosting is documented across Docker, Kubernetes, Linux packages and binaries, Docker Swarm and a Terraform module. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that self-hosted and Cloud features match, and self-hosted equivalents for Cloud-only items (Search Delivery Network, visual dashboard, SSO/RBAC, auto scaling).

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the full engine — same features as the hosted product — on my own infrastructure

citations.quote: The complete API surface is available in the open-source server under GPL-3.0. Self-host it free forever or run the same engine in a dedicated Typesense Cloud cluster.
Typesense **Cloud** is the hosted SaaS version of our **Open Source** product.
Typesense is an open source search engine that can be downloaded and run from your computer locally or from any server.
Typesense includes built-in high availability and the freedom to self-host or use a dedicated Typesense Cloud cluster.
